jobs.title: Python Developer
jobs.descriptionText: We are seeking a Python Developer with strong knowledge of Python, Django web framework, MySQL database, and Docker containerization.
responsibilities: Build scalable web backends with Django and Python.
Design MySQL relational schemas and query optimizations.

jobs.title: Python Backend Developer
jobs.descriptionText: We are looking for a Python Backend Developer proficient in Flask or Django web frameworks. The candidate will design scalable REST APIs, work with SQL databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), use Git version control, and containerize applications with Docker for cloud deployment.
responsibilities: Build and maintain robust backend RESTful APIs using Python and Flask.
Optimize SQL queries and manage relational database schemas.
Containerize backend services using Docker and docker-compose.
Participate in code reviews and maintain clean Git branching standards.

jobs.title: Java Full Stack Engineer
jobs.descriptionText: Seeking an experienced Java Developer specializing in Spring Boot microservices, MySQL database management, REST API integration, and Git workflows.
responsibilities: Develop microservices using Spring Boot and Java 17.
Design database schemas and write efficient SQL queries in MySQL.
Integrate backend services with React frontend applications.
